what: the black-hole viewer's scene (Phase 2): for every map it can show, the files it shades (COMPUTED, graded AGREES in certs/bh-maps-check.json) and the DECIDED shadow edge as a cover of interval boxes from Phase 0's decider, drawn as one solid stroke at least as wide as twice the farthest box corner from its polyline

grid.axes: Bardeen's image plane in units of M, observer at infinity: α to the right, β up along the projected spin axis; λ = −α sin θo, η = (α² − a²) cos²θo + β²

cover.rule: every box of the cover lies within maxDistM of the drawn polyline; the stroke is strokeM ≥ 2·maxDistM wide, so the curve, which lies in the union of the boxes, lies inside the drawn line
